cases.name: closure
cases.js: (function(){function take(q){var o=[];for(var i=0;i<q.length;i++)o.push(q[i]);q.length=0;return o.join('')};var q=[];function push(x){q.push(x)}function drain(){var s=take(q);return s}var r='';push('a');r+=drain();push('b');r+=drain();push('c');r+=drain();push('d');push('e');r+=drain();return r+'|'+JSON.stringify([q.length,q[0],q[1],0 in q])})()

cases.name: closure_let
cases.js: (function(){let q=[];const push=x=>q.push(x);const drain=()=>{const s=q.join('');q.length=0;return s};let r='';for(let i=0;i<5;i++){push('a'+i);push('b'+i);r+=drain()+',';}return r+q.length})()

cases.name: for_of_drain

cases.name: for_of_live

cases.name: reqs_chain
cases.js: (function(){var queue=[],done=[];function enq(x){queue.push(x)}function pump(){var items=queue;var n=items.length;for(var i=0;i<n;i++){done.push(items[i]);if(items[i]<5)enq(items[i]+1)}queue.length=0}enq(0);for(var t=0;t<8;t++)pump();return done.join(',')+'|'+queue.length})()
